section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study conducted in São Paulo, Brazil, consisting of 288 individuals (152 women, 136 men) recruited from the community, with ages ranging from 18-40 years (mean 24.01 years) and self-reported BMI ranging from 18.87-38.42 kg/m² (mean 24.17). The sample was predominantly white (85.7%), with 69.2% having college or higher education (61.2% undergraduate, 8.0% graduate).
